name: Scan
doc: Scan (spell): one emitter per action - its sound, the reticle closing on the target with its brackets and ring, the screen dimmed, the scan bars, the camera to the target, the viewer (the target's name and scan text, turned and zoomed with the pad) until confirmed, the camera back; the result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag040_scan.cpp) run on the program's memory (its camera state too, through its exe pointer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Scanner
parts.doc: One emitter per action: its sound, the reticle and its brackets, the screen dimmer, the scan bars, the camera to the target, the viewer and its text

groups.label: Camera
groups.doc: Its blend a tick (4096: all of it): to the target, to the close view, to the next action's target; the projection there

groups.label: Brackets
groups.doc: The four sliding brackets on the reticle

groups.label: Scan bars
groups.doc: Their fade in and out a tick, their brightness

params.label: Sound
params.doc: Played at the emitter's first tick

params.label: Projection
params.doc: The projection distance of the view

params.label: Follow
params.doc: Ticks on the reticle before they slide out

params.label: Grow
params.doc: Their growth a tick when sliding out (4096: their size)

params.label: Flipbook 15D07D4
params.doc: The sprite sequence at 0x15D07D4 (a flipbook of 32 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Flipbook 15D0AF8
params.doc: The sprite sequence at 0x15D0AF8 (a flipbook of 4 frames: an edited one keeps as many)
